summary: Curbline Properties Corp. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a forward-sale offering of 10 million common shares (up to 11.5 million with the underwriters' option) at $30.85 per share, with net proceeds of approximately $306.5 million upon full physical settlement. The forward sale agreements with Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo involve borrowed shares sold to underwriters; Curbline will receive proceeds only upon physical settlement within ~18 months, with potential cash or net-share settlement alternatives. The offering is an ordinary equity capital raise by a REIT, not a special-situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other enumerated special situation. Risk-arb angle: none; this is a standard seasoned equity offering to raise capital for general corporate purposes.
